guides.edit:
# Editing Base

Base is the widget pack every deck pins, and Essentiel requires it. Its seven widgets are text, card, image, shape, chart, table and stack: keep their names and params, or the elements of existing decks stop rendering.

- One widget per file, `widgets/<name>.typ`, whose declared name is the file name. Shared code lives in `_commun.typ`: `placeholder(t, label, height:)`, the frame shown for a missing image, an undrawn chart or a table without data.
- Params: text `body` (rich); card `kicker`, `title` (plain), `body` (rich), `highlight` (flag); image `asset`, `fit` (cover, contain, stretch); shape `shape` (rect, ellipse, line, path), `path` (host); chart `option` (host); table `data` (host); stack `layout` (rows, columns, grid), `count`, `gap`, `children` (flow slot). Do not rename or retype a param; add new ones as optional.
- Sizing is declared in the schema, never by testing a kind: only text declares `typography: true`; image and chart `grow: true`; table `grow: "fit"`; the others keep their height.
- Wrap every plain and rich param in `field()` (the card does it through its `wrap` callback) and stack fields with `fields-stack`; an empty field must never change the layout.
- Colors and sizes come from tokens through `color-of`, `size-of`, `space-of`, `radius-of`, `stroke-of` and `weight-of`, never literals. Pass `lenient: true` to `color-of` only for colors from the element's style.
- Card and table read `ctx.component.card` and `ctx.component.table`. A new component token goes in this manifest's `tokens`, with a default that names a theme token (bg, ink, accent, md…); themes override it under component.base.
- Contrast to keep with the defaults: card text on `bg`; highlight-ink, highlight-title and highlight-kicker on highlight-bg (ink); table header-color on header-bg (on-accent on accent).
- Table cell texts are plain strings, never Typst markup or eval. Keep the guards (100 rows, 20 columns), and scale a table down only if it still overflows after wrapping.
- Shape paths accept `M`, `L`, `C`, `Q` and `Z` only, with coordinates relative to the frame, matching the host's parser.
- The default element style of shape (`styles.shape`: surface fill, md radius) is part of the manifest.
- Example texts are `ftl:session-example-base-…` markers whose keys exist in all 20 locales.
guides.use:
# Using Base

Base holds the element widgets every deck pins: `base/text`, `base/card`, `base/image`, `base/shape`, `base/chart`, `base/table` and `base/stack`. Put them in a slide's blocks (laid out by the slide) or its elements (placed freely on the slide's grid).

## Which widget

- `base/text`: prose, bullet and numbered lists, headings. The only widget with typography: size, color, weight, font, align, leading, spacing, indent, inset and valign come from the element's style. Prefer one text holding a list to several texts.
- `base/card`: one point in a box: `kicker`, `title`, a rich `body`, and `highlight` to put it on the theme's dark highlight colors. Use 2 to 4 cards side by side for parallel points; highlight one at most. In a frame or a grid cell, a card fills its place.
- `base/image`: a deck asset (`asset`), `fit` cover (crops to fill, the default), contain (whole image) or stretch. In the flow it keeps its proportions.
- `base/shape`: rect, ellipse, line or path, styled by fill, stroke, stroke-width and radius; it defaults to a `surface` fill and `md` radius. A path is `{"d": "M x y L x y C … Q … Z"}`, coordinates relative to the frame (0 to 1). Use shapes for accents, separators and diagrams, not as text boxes.
- `base/chart`: an ECharts-style `option` (bar, line, pie, scatter, radar, waterfall), colored by the theme's chart.palette.
- `base/table`: cells in `data.dataset.source`, one array per row; the first row is the header unless `header-row` is false; `header-column`, `striped` and a per-column `align` are optional. At most 100 rows and 20 columns. Numbers are written in the deck language; true shows ✓. Cells are plain text.
- `base/stack`: keeps flow children together in rows, columns or a grid of `count` columns, with a `gap` from xs to xxl (default lg).

## Height in a slide's blocks

Text, card, shape and stack keep their own height; image and chart share the height left; a table keeps its height when it fits its share, otherwise it takes one and shrinks to fit.

## Avoid

- Literal colors where a theme color name fits (ink, ink-muted, accent, on-accent, surface, rule): theme names follow a theme change, literals do not.
- Long paragraphs in cards, more than 4 cards in a row, a table for two or three numbers (cards or a chart read better).
- Shapes or stacked texts that imitate a card, a list or a table.

## Theme tokens

Base's component tokens restyle every card or table of the deck at once:

- component.base.card: bg, border-color, border-width, radius, top-rule-color, top-rule-width, padding-x, padding-y, title-size, title-weight, title-color, gap, height (auto or fill), highlight-bg, highlight-ink, highlight-title, highlight-kicker.
- component.base.table: size, header-bg, header-color, header-weight, body-bg, stripe-bg, rule-color, rule-width, padding-x, padding-y.
